points: Your site shows 8882 reviews, yet none of your 30 live ads carry that number. A first time buyer has no reason to trust the jewelry yet. Put 8882 on the creative and open two ads with a customer review quote.

12 of your 30 ads say Shop now and send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown. A buyer who clicked has to hunt for the piece. Point those 12 ads to the exact product or collection each one shows.

Your 29 copy ads open with 13 different stories, and the biggest leads only 6 of them. Buyers see a new opening so no single message sticks. Pick your two best openers and build the next batch from them.

All 30 ads use Shop now, including the store ads, which need directions, not a cart. A button that ignores the page leaves the next step unclear. Switch store ads to Get directions and keep Shop now for product pages.
